result.summary: The client previously required a 95% test pass rate for acceptance. The Product Manager now suggests 90% is acceptable for the pilot, but client approval has not been obtained. QA continues to use 95% in the acceptance checklist. No schedule impact was discussed.

issues.description: QA is still using 95% in the acceptance checklist despite the Product Manager suggesting 90% is acceptable for the pilot.
issues.impact: The acceptance criteria are not aligned with the proposed pilot requirement, which may lead to confusion or rejection of the pilot.
evidence: QA is still using 95% in the acceptance checklist.

issues.description: Client approval has not been obtained for the 90% pass rate proposal.
issues.impact: The project is still operating under the original 95% requirement, which may not align with the pilot's actual needs.
evidence: Client approval has not been obtained.
Product Manager said that 90% would be acceptable for the pilot.

uncertainties.item: Client approval for the 90% pass rate proposal
uncertainties.reason: Client approval has not been obtained.
uncertainties.needed_information: Whether the client will approve the 90% pass rate for the pilot.
